detail.longDescription: Hi everyone! I have built an AI health device (ESP8266 + 240*240 screen). It can show AI Agents' status in real time with breathing bubble. And remind user dringking water, toilet, streth, etc. support: DeepSeek Harness, opencode, OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cursor. Hardware design, firmware and plugins are all opensource. urls are here: https://github.com/lovaxi/Rubato_Device https://github.com/lovaxi/Rubato_Plugins Type-c power supply, 2.4G wifi. Online sell on Tindie: https://www.tindie.com/products/beartificialintelligence/rub... . But building your own is also OK. Ask me anything. Thanks.
